worked.problem: A solid sphere has radius 6 cm. Find its volume and total exposed surface area in terms of π.
actions: Mark the radius from centre to surface: 6 cm.
Choose the full-sphere volume formula: 4/3πr³.
Volume = 4/3π(6)³=288π cm³.
Sphere area = 4πr² = 144π cm²; it has no flat base.
Answer: volume 288π cm³; total exposed surface area 144π cm². Compare squared area units with cubed volume units.

volume 972π cm³; total exposed surface area 243π cm²
volume 243π cm³; total exposed surface area 486π cm²
volume 486π cm³; total exposed surface area 243π cm²
reassessment.memo: Mark the radius from centre to surface: 9 cm. Choose the half-sphere volume formula: 2/3πr³. Volume = 2/3π(9)³=486π cm³. Curved hemisphere area = 2πr² = 162π cm²; add the exposed flat disc 81π cm². Answer: volume 486π cm³; total exposed surface area 243π cm². Compare squared area units with cubed volume units.
